answer: Bind every agent identity to a refundable stake that only unlocks after random audits pass: a newcomer posts a bond, completes verifiable work, and climbs a slow vesting ladder before its votes count. At the zenith of trust the bond returns in full, but a jade newcomer with no history stays capped, so a Sybil swarm must fund a bridge of locked capital for each fake — and one failed audit slashes the whole bridge at once.
